context: A retired exec mentors a younger boss about coaching clients
purpose: Teach: 除き/主宰/遵守/合致/猶予/なおし/パーソナル/シニア

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 広志さん、最近うちのコーチング部門、シニア層のクライアントが急に増えてまして、正直手探りなんです。
lines.en: Hiroshi-san, our coaching division has suddenly seen a surge in senior-tier clients, and honestly I'm fumbling.
lines.style: Younger boss opens humbly, admitting uncertainty to elder mentor.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ほう。私が現役の頃も、五十代以上のお客様にはパーソナルな関係性を築くのが何より大事だった。
lines.en: Oh. Even in my active days, building a personal relationship with clients over fifty was the most important thing.
lines.style: Elder reflects warmly, drawing on decades of personal experience.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: それなんですよ。マニュアルを遵守するだけじゃ、相手の本音に合致した提案ができなくて。
lines.en: That's exactly it. Just following the manual won't produce proposals that match what they really want.
lines.style: Boss leans in, frustration visible in his honest tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 私が長年主宰してきた勉強会でもね、若いコーチほど台本を一度書きなおして、自分の言葉に変える子が伸びる。
lines.en: In the study group I've hosted for years, the young coaches who rewrite the script in their own words are the ones who grow.
lines.style: Mentor shares insight gently, weaving in his own teaching practice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: なるほど…ただ、四半期目標があるので、悠長にやり直す猶予がないチームも多くて。
lines.en: I see... but with quarterly targets, many teams don't have the leeway to redo things at leisure.
lines.style: Boss pushes back politely, voicing realistic corporate pressure.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 君ね、新人を除きベテラン全員に一週間だけでも余白を渡してごらん。質が変わるよ。
lines.en: Listen, except for the newcomers, give all your veterans even one week of breathing room. The quality will change.
lines.style: Elder advises firmly, his voice carrying calm authority and conviction.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 一週間ですか…上にどう説明するか悩みますが、やってみる価値はありそうです。
lines.en: A whole week, huh... I'm not sure how to explain it upstairs, but it sounds worth trying.
lines.style: Boss murmurs thoughtfully, already calculating how to pitch upward.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: コーチングはね、数字より人を見る仕事だ。それを忘れない君なら、きっと正しい道を選ぶよ。
lines.en: Coaching is a job of seeing people, not numbers. If you remember that, you'll surely choose the right path.
lines.style: Elder closes with warm encouragement, voice softening into paternal tone.
